dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' shaped structures are visible in the central-lateral region. These features consist of high-luminance white perimeters surrounding low-luminance dark circular cores. The transition at the outer perimeter is a sharp gradient from the dark fur to the high-intensity light ring, which then drops sharply into the dark central interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of solid white high-intensity pixel clusters localized in the anterior neck area (left). A secondary high density of solid dark low-intensity pixels is observed in the interstitial spaces between the macro-annuli in the mid-body region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli in the mid-section form a trapezoidal geometric relationship. Three smaller, adjacent 'O' structures located near the dorsal ridge form a compact, near-equilateral triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a visible pectoral flipper with five distinct digits ending in high-contrast, dark keratinized claws.
